name: CNS wavelet-band colored per-step noise
plain: Per-step noise whose subband energy is decided by what the latent has already built. Haar-transforms x, measures energy per band, and gives more noise to bands that are unresolved. Total energy kept by RMS normalization.
math:
E_b = energy of band b of x_t; γ_b=clamp(E_b/ΣE/γ_scale,0,1); β_b=(1−γ_b)^power; β_b←β_b/√(mean β²).
noise bands ×β_b, inverse Haar, rescaled to orig std; lerp with original by strength.
label: from code
surprise: Among entries read here, the only one whose noise spectrum follows the current latent at each step.
